backend/main.mo: Motoko canister handling user profiles, habit data structures, habit creation, and completion tracking with access control checks.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking a specific UI change to affected frontend files, components, and test identifiers.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing roles of various frontend files in the habit‑tracking UI and logic.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles defining OKLCH color variables and light/dark theme tokens.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component configuring React Query, layout structure, header/footer, and global toaster notifications.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthRequire: Alert component prompting users to sign in with Internet Identity to access habit data.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthStateIn: Badge that displays whether the user is signed in based on Internet Identity state.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Button handling Internet Identity login/logout flow with loading state and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/features/becoming/api/queri: React Query hooks for fetching and mutating habit data, normalizing backend errors, and managing actor initialization state.
frontend/src/features/becoming/component: Main habit view orchestrating auth checks, loading/error states, month selection, and rendering the habit grid and volume summary.
Destructive-style alert showing user-friendly backend errors with an optional retry action.
Renders skeleton placeholders for the habit grid, including month tabs, headers, and habit rows.
Modal for editing a habit’s name, unit type, and volume with validation and API updates.
Displays the habit grid with day headers and habit rows, handling empty states and month-based day counts.
Defines shared layout constants and utilities for sizing and aligning habit grid columns.
Provides UI for adding a new habit with input handling and mutation calls.
Renders a single habit row with info, daily completion checkboxes, actions popover, and edit modal control.
Popover attached to a habit row offering an edit action trigger.
Aggregates and displays monthly totals for rep- and time-based habits.
Renders month selection tabs for navigating between months of 2026.
frontend/src/features/becoming/constants: Defines 2026 month metadata and helpers for retrieving month info and day counts.
frontend/src/features/becoming/state/hab: Builds habit completion maps, retrieves monthly completion and volume info, and formats time or numeric volume values.
frontend/src/features/becoming/utils/tim: Validates, parses, normalizes, and formats time strings in M or M:SS formats for volume tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, reinitializing and invalidating dependent queries on identity change.
frontend/src/hooks/useActorWithTimeout.t: Initializes a backend actor with timeout and normalized error handling, supporting manual retries and query invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity login state, loading stored identities, and exposing login, clear, and status helpers via context.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind-based global styles and a light themed design system with custom colors, surfaces, and touch optimizations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with Internet Identity and React Query providers.
frontend/src/utils/icErrors.ts: Normalizes IC errors and detects stopped-canister conditions to produce safer, user‑friendly messages.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters, persist them in sessionStorage, and remove hash parameters for routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, typography, animations, container settings, and plugins.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s metadata, known issues, and feature requests related to removing a Total Volume row.
